WITH matched_records AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
type_counts AS (
  SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM matched_records
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
stats AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_types
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT 
  tc.tradekind,
  tc.count,
  CAST(tc.count AS REAL) / s.total_count as share,
  CAST(tc.count AS REAL) / s.total_count - (1.0 / s.num_types) as diff_from_avg
FROM type_counts tc
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE s.total_count IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(tc.count AS REAL) / s.total_count > (1.0 / s.num_types)
ORDER BY tc.tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: A 'missing type' refers to a NULL value in the tradekind field, which is treated as a separate grouping category
